availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Route 113/114 and Meteor Falls is reached after Mauville/Wattson (cap 30) via Route 111 -> Route 112 -> Fiery Path, per Game Book C20/C21. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113/114 and Meteor Falls: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Meteor Falls is reached west along Route 114 from Fallarbor per Game Book C21. Adds Petalburg Woods (Kartana gate 20) and NewMauville_Entrance (Magnezone gate 30). Gyaradosite stone window 20; the Mega Ring is earned from Steven after Brawly (C13).
plan: Nicolas is the dragon-tamer ace and his dossier names the counterplay itself: Ground immunity, speed reversal, Fairy/Ice pressure, and denying a safe Dragon Dance. Excadrill leads because a Ground type is flatly immune to Dracozolt's Bolt Beak, which is the single scariest move on the team - a Hustle-boosted Bolt Beak from full Speed on a switch-in is the interaction the dossier says to remember, and I intend to make it a dead move rather than survive it. Togekiss is the second lead: it is immune to High Horsepower, it redirects with Follow Me, and its Dazzling Gleam is 2x into all four members while Altaria is still Dragon/Flying. The moment Altaria Megas it becomes Dragon/Fairy and my Fairy damage stops mattering, so the Steel lane takes over: Excadrill's Iron Head, Magnezone's Flash Cannon and Kartana's Smart Strike are all 2x into Mega Altaria. Mega Gyarados is my ace and is chosen for Intimidate as much as for damage - it is the cheapest answer to both a Dragon Dance sweep and a physical Hustle attacker - and its Ice Fang is 4x into Alolan Exeggutor. I will not try to kill Altaria before it Mega Evolves; the Mega is the showcase and it should be allowed to happen.
